text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian football team Club Africain beat Saint-Pierroise of Reunion 6-1 in an Africain Champions Cup second round played on Sunday in Tunis.
- Self-sufficiency in red meat nearly reached. Red meat production in 1996 covered about 96 percent of consumption needs.
- Nearly 90 percent of Tunisian industry sector is formed of small amd medium entreprises.

- Some 500 people from Volkswagen Spain arrived over the weekend in the southern city of Tozeur, in the Jerid oasis, for their annual gathering. A good sign for the direct flight Madrid-Tozeur expected to start next autumn.
